lines.text: Researchers found that many apps built with AI left private data open to anyone.
Lovable turns plain-English ideas into web apps, which often keep their data in a database service called Supabase.
lines.title: How these apps work

lines.text: Researchers studied 159,041 Lovable projects. Of those, 34,545 used Supabase.
lines.title: What they checked

lines.text: Among 24,664 sites that sent records on load, about three in ten had tables holding email addresses.
lines.title: Sites with email tables

lines.text: Examples included forum profiles, chat messages, ticket sales, and more than a thousand passport records.
lines.title: What was reachable

lines.text: The researchers warn the thirty percent is not a confirmed leak rate, since some emails may be public on purpose.
lines.title: Read with care

lines.text: Easy builders do not remove the need to check who can see what, before real data goes in.
lines.title: Takeaways
